verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for an orchestration platform, especially for the hosted Dagster+ offering. However, the pack has no documented way to export run history, metadata, or other Dagster data in open formats, and no migration-out path. Code-defined assets and OSS Docker deployment are adjacent to portability, not an export capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
